# Province scope: 1 where the province is set to Hands off.

}

# Province scope: the focus band (build below, stored months). No focus set = the first preset.
pp_cplan_band_lo = {
	value = 6
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_focus }
		if = {
			limit = { var:pp_cplan_focus > 100.5 var:pp_cplan_focus < 101.5 }
			value = 6
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:pp_cplan_focus > 101.5 var:pp_cplan_focus < 102.5 }
			value = 8
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:pp_cplan_focus > 102.5 var:pp_cplan_focus < 103.5 }
			value = 6
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:pp_cplan_focus > 103.5 var:pp_cplan_focus < 104.5 }
			value = 4
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:pp_cplan_focus > 105.5 has_variable = pp_cplan_lo }
			value = var:pp_cplan_lo
			subtract = 100
		}
	}
}
# Province scope: the focus band (stop above, stored months). No focus set = the first preset.

		subtract = 100

# Location scope: months of the market's demand its stock holds (99 where nobody asks for it).
pp_cplan_months_camels = {
	value = 99
	if = {
		limit = { market ?= { "goods_demand_in_market(goods:camels)" > 0.01 } }
		value = "market.stockpile_in_market(goods:camels)"
		divide = "market.goods_demand_in_market(goods:camels)"
	}
	max = 99
}
# Country scope: the same for the capital's market (the panel).
pp_cplan_cap_months_camels = {
	value = 0
	capital ?= { add = pp_cplan_months_camels }
	max = 99
}
# Location scope: where to build first (output modifier, standing producers far first).
pp_cplan_site_camels = {
	value = 100
	add = { value = modifier:local_camels_output_modifier multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_building = building_type:camel_herders has_building = building_type:camel_stud } }
		add = 1000
	}
	min = 1
}

		divide = "market.goods_demand_in_market(goods:cloves)"
	}
	max = 99
}
# Country scope: the same for the capital's market (the panel).
pp_cplan_cap_months_cloves = {
	value = 0
	capital ?= { add = pp_cplan_months_cloves }
	max = 99
}
# Location scope: where to build first (output modifier, standing producers far first).
pp_cplan_site_cloves = {
	value = 100
	add = { value = modifier:local_cloves_output_modifier multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_building = building_type:clove_grove } }
		add = 1000
	}
	min = 1
}

# Location scope: months of the market's demand its stock holds (99 where nobody asks for it).
pp_cplan_months_pearls = {
	value = 99
	if = {
		limit = { market ?= { "goods_demand_in_market(goods:pearls)" > 0.01 } }
		value = "market.stockpile_in_market(goods:pearls)"
		divide = "market.goods_demand_in_market(goods:pearls)"
	}
	max = 99
}

	value = 0
	capital ?= { add = pp_cplan_months_pearls }
	max = 99
}

		limit = { market ?= { "goods_demand_in_market(goods:jewelry)" > 0.01 } }
		value = "market.stockpile_in_market(goods:jewelry)"
		divide = "market.goods_demand_in_market(goods:jewelry)"
	}
	max = 99
}

	max = 99

	}

# saltpeter: Country scope: the mode (0 off, 1 keep stocked, 2 expand within the payback line, 3 never).
pp_cplan_mode_saltpeter = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_g_saltpeter }
		value = var:pp_cplan_g_saltpeter
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# Location scope: months of the market's demand its stock holds (99 where nobody asks for it).
pp_cplan_months_saltpeter = {
	value = 99
	if = {
		limit = { market ?= { "goods_demand_in_market(goods:saltpeter)" > 0.01 } }
		value = "market.stockpile_in_market(goods:saltpeter)"
		divide = "market.goods_demand_in_market(goods:saltpeter)"
	}
	max = 99
}
# Country scope: the same for the capital's market (the panel).
pp_cplan_cap_months_saltpeter = {
	value = 0
	capital ?= { add = pp_cplan_months_saltpeter }
	max = 99
}
# Location scope: where to build first (output modifier, standing producers far first).
pp_cplan_site_saltpeter = {
	value = 100
	add = { value = modifier:local_saltpeter_output_modifier multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_building = building_type:putrefaction_mill has_building = building_type:putrefaction_works has_building = building_type:saltpeter_beds has_building = building_type:saltpeter_guild has_building = building_type:saltpeter_workshop } }
		add = 1000
	}
	min = 1
}

# ---- Build cost: the construction goods' price factor (location scope, its market) ----
# Each good's price / default price, clamped to 0.5..2.5 (1 + MIN/MAX_PRICE_IMPACT), averaged by the
# demand's amounts; 1 where the location has no market or the demand names no goods.

pp_cplan_cd_academy_construction = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { market ?= { always = yes } }
		value = 0
		add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:books)" divide = "default_price(goods:books)" min = 0.5 max = 2.5 multiply = 1 }
		add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:masonry)" divide = "default_price(goods:masonry)" min = 0.5 max = 2.5 multiply = 2 }
		add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:paper)" divide = "default_price(goods:paper)" min = 0.5 max = 2.5 multiply = 2 }
		add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:tools)" divide = "default_price(goods:tools)" min = 0.5 max = 2.5 multiply = 1 }
		divide = 6
	}
}
pp_cplan_cd_admiralty_construction = {

	if = {
		limit = { market ?= { always = yes } }
		value = 0
		add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:fine_cloth)" divide = "default_price(goods:fine_cloth)" min = 0.5 max = 2.5 multiply = 1 }
		add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:glass)" divide = "default_price(goods:glass)" min = 0.5 max = 2.5 multiply = 1 }
		add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:marble)" divide = "default_price(goods:marble)" min = 0.5 max = 2.5 multiply = 2 }
		add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:masonry)" divide = "default_price(goods:masonry)" min = 0.5 max = 2.5 multiply = 5 }
		add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:naval_supplies)" divide = "default_price(goods:naval_supplies)" min = 0.5 max = 2.5 multiply = 1 }
		add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:tools)" divide = "default_price(goods:tools)" min = 0.5 max = 2.5 multiply = 4 }
		divide = 14
	}

	if = {
		limit = { market ?= { always = yes } }
		value = 0
		add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:books)" divide = "default_price(goods:books)" min = 0.5 max = 2.5 multiply = 1 }
		add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:masonry)" divide = "default_price(goods:masonry)" min = 0.5 max = 2.5 multiply = 1 }
		add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:paper)" divide = "default_price(goods:paper)" min = 0.5 max = 2.5 multiply = 2 }
		divide = 4
	}
}

# ---- Location rules: conditions (location scope, in the panel's units) ----

pp_cplan_m_population = {
	value = population
}
pp_cplan_m_peasants = {
	value = num_pop_type:peasants
}
pp_cplan_m_idle_peasants = {
	value = "unemployed_pops_of_pop_type_in_location(pop_type:peasants)"
}
pp_cplan_m_idle_laborers = {
	value = "unemployed_pops_of_pop_type_in_location(pop_type:laborers)"
}
pp_cplan_m_employment = {
	value = employment_percentage
	multiply = 100
}
pp_cplan_m_market_access = {
	value = market_access
	multiply = 100
}
pp_cplan_m_control = {
	value = local_control
	multiply = 100
}
pp_cplan_m_proximity = {
	value = proximity
}
pp_cplan_m_development = {
	value = development
}
pp_cplan_m_prosperity = {
	value = prosperity
	multiply = 100
}
pp_cplan_m_stored_food = {
	value = pp_cplan_stored_here
}
pp_cplan_m_arable_land = {
	value = pp_cplan_farm_site
}
pp_cplan_m_building_levels = {
	value = total_building_levels
}
pp_cplan_m_tax_base = {
	value = location_tax_base
}
pp_cplan_m_rgo_profit = {
	value = rgo_profit
}
pp_cplan_m_literacy = {
	value = average_location_literacy
}
pp_cplan_m_coastal = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { is_coastal = yes }
		value = 1
	}
}
pp_cplan_m_river = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_river = yes }
		value = 1
	}
}

# Any scope: the conditions' count and the last id + 100 (the cycle wraps after it).
pp_cplan_metric_count = { value = 18 }
pp_cplan_metric_last100 = { value = 118 }
# Any scope: the highest level a rule can ask for, + 100.
pp_cplan_max_rule_level100 = { value = 130 }
# Country scope: the mode template 1 sets (0 the plan's rules, 1 own rules, 2 hands off).
pp_cplan_t1_mode_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_t1_mode }
		value = var:pp_cplan_t1_mode
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# Country scope: the mode template 2 sets (0 the plan's rules, 1 own rules, 2 hands off).
pp_cplan_t2_mode_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_t2_mode }
		value = var:pp_cplan_t2_mode
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# Country scope: the mode template 3 sets (0 the plan's rules, 1 own rules, 2 hands off).
pp_cplan_t3_mode_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_t3_mode }
		value = var:pp_cplan_t3_mode
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# Country scope: the mode template 4 sets (0 the plan's rules, 1 own rules, 2 hands off).
pp_cplan_t4_mode_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_t4_mode }
		value = var:pp_cplan_t4_mode
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# Country scope: 1 once profile 1 is saved.
pp_cplan_p1_saved_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_p1_saved }
		value = 1
	}
}
# Country scope: 1 once profile 2 is saved.
pp_cplan_p2_saved_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_p2_saved }
		value = 1
	}
}

		value = 1
	}
}

# ---- Rule 1 of a location (location scope) ----
# 1 while the rule names a building.
pp_cplan_r1_set_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_r1_b }
		value = 1
	}
}
# The level the rule builds up to.
pp_cplan_r1_lv_n = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_r1_lv }
		value = var:pp_cplan_r1_lv
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# The levels that stood here at the plan's last look.
pp_cplan_r1_has_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_r1_has }
		value = var:pp_cplan_r1_has
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# The condition id (0 = always).
pp_cplan_r1_m_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_r1_m }
		value = var:pp_cplan_r1_m
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# 1 = the condition holds below the threshold, 0 = at it or above.
pp_cplan_r1_below_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_r1_c }
		value = var:pp_cplan_r1_c
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# The threshold, in the condition's units.
pp_cplan_r1_t_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_r1_t }
		value = var:pp_cplan_r1_t
		subtract = 100000
	}
}
# The payback limit in years (0 = any).
pp_cplan_r1_pb_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_r1_pb }
		value = var:pp_cplan_r1_pb
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# The rule's state after the last pass (0 not run yet, 1 started, 2 waiting for its condition, 3 done, 4 a level under construction, 5 payback too long, 6 cannot be built now, 7 held back by the budget, 8 the market lacks its construction goods).
pp_cplan_r1_st_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_r1_st }
		value = var:pp_cplan_r1_st
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# The condition's value here now.
pp_cplan_r1_now = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_r1_m }
		if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 100.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 101.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_population }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 101.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 102.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_peasants }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 102.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 103.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_idle_peasants }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 103.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 104.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_idle_laborers }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 104.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 105.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_employment }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 105.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 106.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_market_access }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 106.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 107.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_control }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 107.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 108.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_proximity }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 108.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 109.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_development }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 109.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 110.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_prosperity }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 110.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 111.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_stored_food }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 111.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 112.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_arable_land }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 112.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 113.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_building_levels }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 113.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 114.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_tax_base }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 114.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 115.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_rgo_profit }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 115.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 116.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_literacy }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 116.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 117.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_coastal }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 117.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 118.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_river }
	}
}
# One step of the threshold arrows.
pp_cplan_r1_step = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_r1_m }
		if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 100.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 101.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 101.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 102.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 102.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 103.5 } value = 0.5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 103.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 104.5 } value = 0.5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 104.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 105.5 } value = 5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 105.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 106.5 } value = 5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 106.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 107.5 } value = 5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 107.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 108.5 } value = 5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 108.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 109.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 109.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 110.5 } value = 5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 110.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 111.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 111.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 112.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 112.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 113.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 113.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 114.5 } value = 0.5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 114.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 115.5 } value = 0.1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 115.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 116.5 } value = 5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 116.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 117.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r1_m > 117.5 var:pp_cplan_r1_m < 118.5 } value = 1 }
	}
}

# ---- Rule 2 of a location (location scope) ----
# 1 while the rule names a building.
pp_cplan_r2_set_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_r2_b }
		value = 1
	}

	if = {

		subtract = 100
	}

		value = var:pp_cplan_r2_has

		value = var:pp_cplan_r2_m

	}

pp_cplan_r2_below_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_r2_c }
		value = var:pp_cplan_r2_c
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# The threshold, in the condition's units.
pp_cplan_r2_t_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_r2_t }
		value = var:pp_cplan_r2_t
		subtract = 100000
	}
}
# The payback limit in years (0 = any).
pp_cplan_r2_pb_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_r2_pb }
		value = var:pp_cplan_r2_pb
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# The rule's state after the last pass (0 not run yet, 1 started, 2 waiting for its condition, 3 done, 4 a level under construction, 5 payback too long, 6 cannot be built now, 7 held back by the budget, 8 the market lacks its construction goods).
pp_cplan_r2_st_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_r2_st }
		value = var:pp_cplan_r2_st
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# The condition's value here now.
pp_cplan_r2_now = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_r2_m }
		if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 100.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 101.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_population }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 101.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 102.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_peasants }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 102.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 103.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_idle_peasants }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 103.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 104.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_idle_laborers }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 104.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 105.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_employment }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 105.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 106.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_market_access }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 106.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 107.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_control }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 107.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 108.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_proximity }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 108.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 109.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_development }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 109.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 110.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_prosperity }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 110.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 111.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_stored_food }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 111.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 112.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_arable_land }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 112.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 113.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_building_levels }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 113.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 114.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_tax_base }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 114.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 115.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_rgo_profit }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 115.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 116.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_literacy }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 116.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 117.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_coastal }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 117.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 118.5 } value = pp_cplan_m_river }
	}
}
# One step of the threshold arrows.
pp_cplan_r2_step = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_r2_m }
		if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 100.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 101.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 101.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 102.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 102.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 103.5 } value = 0.5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 103.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 104.5 } value = 0.5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 104.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 105.5 } value = 5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 105.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 106.5 } value = 5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 106.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 107.5 } value = 5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 107.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 108.5 } value = 5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 108.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 109.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 109.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 110.5 } value = 5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 110.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 111.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 111.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 112.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 112.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 113.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 113.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 114.5 } value = 0.5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 114.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 115.5 } value = 0.1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 115.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 116.5 } value = 5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 116.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 117.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r2_m > 117.5 var:pp_cplan_r2_m < 118.5 } value = 1 }
	}
}

		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r4_m > 112.5 var:pp_cplan_r4_m < 113.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r4_m > 113.5 var:pp_cplan_r4_m < 114.5 } value = 0.5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r4_m > 114.5 var:pp_cplan_r4_m < 115.5 } value = 0.1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r4_m > 115.5 var:pp_cplan_r4_m < 116.5 } value = 5 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r4_m > 116.5 var:pp_cplan_r4_m < 117.5 } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { var:pp_cplan_r4_m > 117.5 var:pp_cplan_r4_m < 118.5 } value = 1 }
	}
}

# the peasant food consumption of the location's Variable Harvest modifier x the peasants' food per head

# Location scope: market access without the event modifiers of [construction_plan] access_blacklist.
pp_cplan_access_normal = {
	value = market_access
	if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = staple_port_commercial_stagnation_modifier } subtract = -0.25 }
}

# ---- Farms: which line pays back fastest here (location scope, its market) ----
# A level's monthly profit at this market's prices and this location's output: each slot's best method
# (production efficiency, staffing and market access left out: the same for every line here). Its yearly
# return in % of the tier's base price (pp_cplan_farm_roi_<tier>); a line's return is that of its highest tier
# that can be built here (a standing older tier is replaced once its successor is researched).

pp_cplan_fm_wheat_farm_1_1 = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:wheat)" multiply = { value = modifier:local_wheat_output_modifier add = 1 min = 0 } multiply = 0.06 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:manual_labor)" multiply = 0.012 }
}
pp_cplan_fs_wheat_farm_1 = {
	value = pp_cplan_fm_wheat_farm_1_1
}
pp_cplan_fm_wheat_farm_2_1 = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:wheat)" multiply = { value = modifier:local_wheat_output_modifier add = 1 min = 0 } multiply = 0.15 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:livestock)" multiply = 0.037 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:lumber)" multiply = 0.021 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:manual_labor)" multiply = 0.024 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:tools)" multiply = 0.002 }
}
pp_cplan_fm_wheat_farm_2_2 = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:wheat)" multiply = { value = modifier:local_wheat_output_modifier add = 1 min = 0 } multiply = 0.166 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:horses)" multiply = 0.016 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:lumber)" multiply = 0.029 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:manual_labor)" multiply = 0.026 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:tools)" multiply = 0.003 }
}
pp_cplan_fs_wheat_farm_2 = {
	value = pp_cplan_fm_wheat_farm_2_1
	min = pp_cplan_fm_wheat_farm_2_2
	min = 0
}
pp_cplan_fm_wheat_farm_3_1 = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:local_food)" multiply = { value = modifier:local_local_food_output_modifier add = 1 min = 0 } multiply = 1.5 }
	subtract = { value = "market.market_price(goods:wheat)" multiply = 0.01 }
}
pp_cplan_fs_wheat_farm_3 = {
	value = pp_cplan_fm_wheat_farm_3_1
}
pp_cplan_farm_est_wheat_farm = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { market ?= { always = yes } }
		add = pp_cplan_fs_wheat_farm_1
		add = pp_cplan_fs_wheat_farm_2
		add = pp_cplan_fs_wheat_farm_3
	}
}
pp_cplan_farm_roi_wheat_farm = {
	value = pp_cplan_farm_est_wheat_farm
	multiply = 1200
	divide = { value = building_type:wheat_farm.building_base_cost_in_gold min = 1 }
}

# Location scope: the wheat line's return here (0 where no tier can be built or its good is set to Never).
pp_cplan_farm_line_roi_wheat = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { pp_cplan_mode_wheat < 2.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = wheat_model_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:wheat_model_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_wheat_model_farm
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = wheat_rotations } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:wheat_rotations building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_wheat_rotations
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = wheat_farmstead } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:wheat_farmstead building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_wheat_farmstead
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = wheat_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:wheat_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_wheat_farm
		}
	}
}

# Location scope: the millet line's return here (0 where no tier can be built or its good is set to Never).
pp_cplan_farm_line_roi_millet = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { pp_cplan_mode_millet < 2.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = millet_model_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:millet_model_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_millet_model_farm
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = millet_rotations } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:millet_rotations building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_millet_rotations
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = millet_farmstead } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:millet_farmstead building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_millet_farmstead
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = millet_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:millet_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_millet_farm
		}
	}
}

# Location scope: the legume line's return here (0 where no tier can be built or its good is set to Never).
pp_cplan_farm_line_roi_legume = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { pp_cplan_mode_legumes < 2.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = legume_model_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:legume_model_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_legume_model_farm
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = legume_rotations } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:legume_rotations building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_legume_rotations
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = legume_farmstead } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:legume_farmstead building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_legume_farmstead
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = legume_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:legume_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_legume_farm
		}
	}
}

# Location scope: the olive line's return here (0 where no tier can be built or its good is set to Never).
pp_cplan_farm_line_roi_olive = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { pp_cplan_mode_olives < 2.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = olive_model_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:olive_model_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_olive_model_farm
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = olive_rotations } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:olive_rotations building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_olive_rotations
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = olive_farmstead } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:olive_farmstead building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_olive_farmstead
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = olive_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:olive_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_olive_farm
		}
	}
}

# Location scope: the camel_herders line's return here (0 where no tier can be built or its good is set to Never).
pp_cplan_farm_line_roi_camel_herders = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { pp_cplan_mode_camels < 2.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = camel_stud } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:camel_stud building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_camel_stud
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = camel_herders } pp_cplan_goods_here_basic_construction_needs = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:camel_herders building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_camel_herders
		}
	}
}

# Location scope: the forest_village line's return here (0 where no tier can be built or its good is set to Never).
pp_cplan_farm_line_roi_forest_village = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { pp_cplan_mode_beeswax < 2.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = managed_forest_village } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:managed_forest_village building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_managed_forest_village
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = forest_village } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:forest_village building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_forest_village
		}
	}
}

# Location scope: the ocean_fishery line's return here (0 where no tier can be built or its good is set to Never).
pp_cplan_farm_line_roi_ocean_fishery = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { pp_cplan_mode_fish < 2.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = offshore_fishery } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:offshore_fishery building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_offshore_fishery
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = drift_net_fishery } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:drift_net_fishery building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_drift_net_fishery
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = ocean_fishery } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:ocean_fishery building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_ocean_fishery
		}
	}
}

# Location scope: the sheep_farms line's return here (0 where no tier can be built or its good is set to Never).
pp_cplan_farm_line_roi_sheep_farms = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { pp_cplan_mode_wool < 2.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = hurdled_sheepcotes } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:hurdled_sheepcotes building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_hurdled_sheepcotes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = enclosed_sheep_walks } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:enclosed_sheep_walks building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_enclosed_sheep_walks
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = sheep_farms } pp_cplan_goods_here_farm_constructions = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:sheep_farms building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
			value = pp_cplan_farm_roi_sheep_farms
		}
	}
}
